sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 20 sampled native standalone-sheet references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed not established; native heading1959, approval9 April1959; series/catalog 1959. Native standalone20-reference geological legend only, not borrowed from Central/South maps. Actual 1:200000 native printed scale resolves source scale independently of nomenclature. Mineral-resource symbols are overprinted on the geological map but not independently classified or assigned ages. Four actually readable labelled native corner controls, assumed Pulkovo1942/Gauss-Kruger zone10 EPSG28410, affine holdouts, no invented midpoints or surveyed/interior landmarks. Datum/projection and absolute accuracy remain unverified. Native heading1959, mineral information current1 January1959, approval9 April1959; actual printing date not established. Native pale/blue geology retained, no global pale/blue/dark exclusion or missing-geology fill.
sheets.accuracy: 4 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 3.48px, leave-one-out max 14.01px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
